_comment: Values here override what is stored in localStorage and are applied on launch.
Delete the file to go back to whatever the UI last saved.
_eqBands: band count: 4 | 8 | 16. Default is 8. 'eq' is resampled onto this layout.
_visualizer: one of: bars | wave | mirror | radial | pulse | off
_theme: one of: dark | light | red | blue | green | purple | orange | pink. Old ids (midnight, oled, dusk, daylight) are still accepted and mapped. An object like {"accent":"#22d3ee","mode":"dark"} builds a one-off theme from any hex accent.
_autodiscovery: kept for compatibility; autodiscovery is now always on and only yields to Repeat or Shuffle
_proxy: Geo-Bypass proxy to unlock region-restricted SoundCloud tracks. mode: builtin | custom. preset: auto | us | de | gb | nl.
